about_the_game:
----------------------------------------

DEVELOPERS NOTE FOR PLAYTEST

In essence, Stranger Heroes is a survivor-like, but it has an active exploration component, you need to explore the facility, unlock doors, rescue characters. Your passive powers (like hackers hoodie) not only help you in combat, but also necessary to unlock more sections.

Meta progression goes hand in hand with combat and exploration, where we have a unique research, where you need to defeat certain enemies to unlock genetic enhancements for your heroes.

Game is fully playable, it even has an "prologue ending" scene if you can reach it.

Now, back to the page...

---------------------------------------

A catastrophic breach has plunged the top-secret CCA (Central Control Agency) facility into a paranormal nightmare. As a former CCA associate awakened with forgotten powers, you are the last hope. Survive the horde in this action rogue-lite where your abilities fire automatically and strategic movement is your key to survival.

Navigate the corrupted labs and containment zones of the CCA. Stand your ground to unleash a concentrated barrage of fire, or run to evade the endless threats. Collect paranormal relics and experimental tech to craft unique and powerful builds on each run, pushing deeper into the heart of the disaster.

With every attempt, you'll gradually unravel two mysteries: the truth behind the facility's collapse and the forgotten past of the mythic hero you've become.

Collect residual life essence to grow your powers. Craft unique builds combining raw psychic phenomena, paranormal CCA artifacts, and experimental tech. Combine your skills with relics to explore deeper into the CCA compound. Hack the Kerberos security system to access locked blast doors. Find your way through wind tunnels. Evade or aggravate psionic breaches. 

Can you handle the escalating chaos? Can you survive long enough to discover what is truly behind the CCA's fall? Can you fully reawaken the legend within and exalt the strange artifacts calling to you?

How many re-lives are you willing to endure?

Key Features:

  • Auto-Firing, Movement-Focused Combat: Your powers attack automatically. Master your positioning—stand your ground to concentrate fire or weave through enemies to survive.

  • Unravel a Dual Mystery: Piece together the secrets of the CCA's fall while simultaneously uncovering the legendary past of the hero you control.

  • Craft Devastating Builds: Combine paranormal relics, experimental tech, and awakened abilities to create unique synergies that change with every playthrough.

  • Unlock Stranger Heroes: Discover other empowered individuals, each embodying a different mythic figure with their own story and unique powers.

  • Grow Stronger After Death: Death is not the end. Unlock permanent upgrades, new characters, and starting advantages for your next attempt.

  • Explore a Paranormal Hellscape: Battle hordes of twisted scientists, corrupted guards, and otherworldly abominations unleashed by the breach.

  • Awaken the myth. Survive the facility. Uncover the truth.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 LTS or equivalent
  • Processor: 4 Cores / 2.5 GHz+
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Xe / Nvidia GTX 970 / AMD RX 570 (Mesa 22.0)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS or equivalent
  • Processor: 4 Cores / 3.5 GHz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1070 / AMD RX 570 (Mesa 22.0)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: An action roguelite with rewarding exploration and survivor-like gameplay. Explore the secrets of the CCA facility and discover our heroes forgotten past. Unleash your paranormal weapons on the hordes, Exalt your arsenal and earn permanent upgrades to awaken the myth in you ... one life at a time
